subject: POC hosting recommendation & MPA — hosting options and next steps
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@integrate.ai>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@medsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 May 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery call — POC next steps and hosting options

Hi Emily / Alex —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed path for the POC so the team can align: 

Summary of key success criteria we captured:
- Functional: end-to-end clinical summarization and QA workflow with 95% pass on our evaluation prompts (we'll share the eval set).
- Performance: median gen latency < 350ms for 512-token responses; steady throughput of ~120 reqs/min for peak workflows.
- Security/compliance: HIPAA coverage required, audit logs retained for 90 days, SOC‑2 evidence requested.
- Data handling: customer-supplied clinical notes will be de‑identified in the trial; sample schema requested.

Hosting options (tradeoffs) — recommendation at the end: 
1) Hosted API trial (fastest) — Redwood hosted, immediate onboarding (1–2 weeks), full feature set (streaming + function calls). Good for feature validation and prompt tuning. Data isolation: logical; encryption at rest.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity) — dedicated GPUs, predictable throughput and unit economics, better isolation than hosted. Lead: 2–4 week setup for reserved capacity and capacity planning. SLA options available.
3) Private VPC trial — customer VPC with private control plane (best for strict data residency), longest lead time (6–8 weeks), requires IT/security review and network setup.

Recommendation: start with a short hosted API trial to validate prompts and success criteria (2 weeks), then parallel evaluation on a small dedicated sandbox window if you want to stress throughput and latency under representative load. VPC only if the security team requires it for the production rollout.

Proposed timeline & owners:
- Week 0 (this week): sign the mutual action plan (attached) and receive sample data schema (Emily). Owner: Diego (AE).
- Week 1: Hosted trial onboarding + initial prompt tuning. Owner: Marissa (SE).
- Week 2: Run eval suite, capture latency/throughput metrics and quality scores. Owner: Priyom (Onboarding).
- Week 3: Decision point: continue hosted -> production path OR schedule dedicated sandbox window for load validation. Owner: Customer + Diego.

Immediate asks for you to unblock setup:
1) Confirm whether you want to start with hosted API or jump directly to dedicated sandbox.
2) Share a small sample dataset (de‑identified) or schema (CSV/JSON) for Marissa to scope ingestion.
3) Confirm any procurement constraints / PO requirements.

I attached the mutual action plan (MAP) and our standard security questionnaire for your security team to review.

If this looks right, I’ll schedule a 60‑minute technical deep dive with Marissa next week (propose Tue/Thu AM PT).

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com | +1 415‑555‑0123
Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (stated), security-questionnaire.pdf (stated)

From: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@integrate.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@medsys.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 May 2025 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call — POC next steps and hosting options

Diego — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- HIPAA definitely applies; we will provide de‑identified notes for the trial but the security review still needs to state HIPAA controls.
- On performance: the 120 reqs/min is an average; we have occasional bursts up to 300 reqs/min for short windows (2–3 minutes). That may push us toward a dedicated sandbox for the load validation phase.
- Cost / SLA question: what is the pricing delta between hosted trial usage and a short dedicated sandbox window? Also what uptime SLA options exist for dedicated?

We are open to starting hosted to iterate on prompts, but we want a clear path to run a 1–2 day dedicated load run to validate latency under burst. If Redwood can provide a short dedicated window with pricing estimate, that would help.

I can share a de‑identified sample schema by EOD Monday. Can you also include the HubSpot deal link and the MAP as a Doc we can sign electronically?

—Emily
Emily Zhou
Head of Product, IntegrateAI
emily.zhou@integrate.ai | +1 646‑555‑8941

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@integrate.ai>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@medsys.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 May 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call — POC next steps and hosting options

Emily — great, thanks for the quick reply and for confirming HIPAA. Answers inline below: 

> Cost / SLA question: what is the pricing delta between hosted trial usage and a short dedicated sandbox window?
- Hosted trial: usage-based; we’ll provide a dev credit for the trial period (I included a $2k credit in the MAP for evaluations).
- Dedicated sandbox window: short-term reserved capacity pricing is typically quoted as a weekly block; rough ballpark for the capacity you described (sustained 120 rpm with 300 rpm short bursts) is $2.5k–$4k/week depending on GPU profile. I’ll get a formal estimate from finance and include it in the MPA addendum.

> SLA options for dedicated?
- We offer a 99.9% uptime SLA on Dedicated contracts (for annual/reserved purchases). Short evaluation windows can get elevated priority but SLA-backed credits are for committed contracts.

Plan for next steps: 
- I’ll convert the MAP to a DocuSign link (or send as PDF if you prefer) and flag the pricing addendum for the dedicated window.
- Marissa — can you confirm available slots for a 60‑min technical deep dive (Tue/Thu next week AM PT) and the minimal schema requirements for the onboarding ingestion?
- Priyom — I’ll loop you into the MAP and coordinate the hosted account creation once Emily confirms.

Emily — once you share the sample schema we’ll pre-provision a hosted sandbox and run a short smoke test before the deep dive.

Diego
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhou <emily.zhou@integrate.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@medsys.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call — POC next steps and hosting options

Hi Emily / team — looping in technical details and a pre-checklist so we can move fast once we have the sample data. Quick checklist: 

Pre-onboarding checklist for hosted trial:
- Provide one representative file (CSV/JSON) with de‑identified patient notes and schema.
- Confirm required endpoints (chat vs. text-generation vs. embeddings).
- Provide peak expected request pattern (we have the 120 rpm + 300 rpm bursts noted).
- Provide any IP/PII redaction rules we should apply prior to ingestion.

Dedicated sandbox addendum (what we need from IntegrateAI for a short window):
- Approximate sustained throughput and peak burst duration (you mentioned 2–3 min bursts).
- Preferred week(s) for the short stress run (we recommend 2 consecutive weekdays).

Suggested slots for the technical deep dive (60 min):
- Tue 2025‑05‑13 09:00–10:00 PT
- Thu 2025‑05‑15 10:00–11:00 PT

Deliverables from Redwood during the hosted trial:
- Pre-provisioned API key and a lightweight SDK sample repo.
- Eval harness and default prompt set to run the quality checks.
- Latency and token-usage dashboard link for the trial window.

If the above looks good, Diego — please send the DocuSign MAP and I’ll prepare the onboarding checklist plus a short runbook for the dedicated window (if they select it). Emily — looking forward to the schema attachment.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachments referenced: onboarding-checklist.md (stub), dedicated-runbook-outline.md (stub)
